analysis.pairing: ABBA, each pair one A round and the B round next to it
analysis.unit: one summary per round and metric; requests are never pooled across rounds
analysis.zero_rule: ratios exactly 1 carry no sign and are left out of both tests
analysis.tie_rule: TIE when the median ratio and both ends of its confidence interval lie within 1/(1+tie_band) and 1+tie_band; a median inside with an interval outside, or with no interval, is INCONCLUSIVE
analysis.direction_rule: FASTER or SLOWER only when the test leans the same way as the median ratio
analysis.failure_rule: a metric that lost a pair because one side failed on its own account (SIDE_FAILED, SIDE_NEVER_READY, LOAD_FAILED, or failed requests at its level) is INCONCLUSIVE, and so is every metric when the scored rounds ran on more than one node
analysis.family_rule: the correction runs over the primary metrics only; secondary metrics get the same test, interval and tie band with an uncorrected p-value, and their verdicts are descriptive
